asked.item: how long comments and DMs are kept in the Inbox
whether older Instagram DMs from before connecting are pulled in

verdict.reason: Both questions are general Inbox facts that the cited sentences answer directly: the retention period and the lack of any import of older Instagram messages.

steps.text: Comments and messages in the Inbox are retained for up to 45 days.
Blotato does not import older Instagram posts, comments, or direct messages.
The Inbox starts capturing new comments and messages after your account connects with the required permissions.
